faq.question: What is liquid nitrogen used for?
faq.answer: Cryogenic preservation, industrial freezing, medical and laboratory work, and metal treatment. Liquid nitrogen boils at −196°C.

about: Liquid nitrogen (LN₂) is nitrogen cooled to about −196 °C. It is used for cryogenic freezing and shrink-fitting, cold storage of biological samples, food freezing and chilling, and as a cold source in laboratories and events.
It is stored in vacuum-insulated containers that vent as it slowly boils off, so never seal a container tightly. Use cryogenic gloves and face protection and handle it only in well-ventilated areas.
